summary.text: Craig Sullivan is the Republican candidate for Colorado House of Representatives District 34 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A retired air traffic controller, he advanced from the Republican primary on June 30, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Craig Sullivan was born in Stockton, California, graduated from Thornton High School and attended Metropolitan State College.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he worked over 22 years in the tower at Denver International Airport during an FAA controller career of over 31 years, and has lived in or near House District 34 for over 42 years.
Sullivan named the cost of living and housing, crime and immigration as his three key messages in the survey.
He also said he is passionate about improving Colorado's business climate.
